fact: On 21 April 2026 a ministry director said the Startup Act of 2020 was reinforced by decree 2025-270 of 13 February 2025 and that the State is working on a fund to finance seed and start-up stages, with the legal framework providing combined public-private funds and guarantees.
title: Créativité et innovation : plusieurs dispositifs d'accompagnement de l'Etat commencent à produire des effets visibles (tutelle)
